description:
Two dead-assign warnings in `src/fetcher/concurrent_fetcher.cr`:

- **Line 63:** `deadline = Time.instant + timeout` — assigned but never read. The trailing comment says "to prevent hanging everlasting" but the actual timeout uses a separate spawned timer fiber.
- **Line 77:** `selected = select` — `select` returns the chosen branch index; assigning to `selected` with no reader is a no-op.

Pick one of:
- **Option A (simple):** Drop both assignments. Keep the spawned-timer pattern as-is, just remove the misleading variable. Update the comment to not mention a deadline.
- **Option B (cleaner):** Drop both assignments AND the spawned-timer fiber. Inside the `loop`, check `(Time.instant - start) >= timeout` after each receive and break. Removes a fiber and a channel allocation per call.

Option B is preferred if the spawned-timer isn't load-bearing elsewhere (it isn't — only the loop reads it).

Acceptance: `ameba Lint/UselessAssign` clean for this file; full spec suite passes.
title: Clean up concurrent_fetcher dead variables
